_about: Open clinical questions for the oncologist's sign-off of this case's rubric (shown in scripts/build_case_review.py). Each comes from a real grading disagreement or a borderline call on 2026-10-22.

questions.question: Uric acid 10.4, LDH more than 5x the upper limit, creatinine rising 1.1 to 1.5. Several notes give IV hydration plus allopurinol, rasburicase only if uric acid stays above 8 (after G6PD), and 'frequent' TLS labs with no interval. Is that adequate TLS prophylaxis?
questions.context: Today this is an unsafe-error item. The checklist asks for a uric-acid-lowering drug and labs every 6-12 hours for 72 hours. The two graders split on exactly these notes.

questions.question: Is a prednisone prephase (about 100 mg for 5-7 days) required for this 67-year-old with ECOG 2 and bulky high-risk disease?
questions.context: Today it is required but not unsafe (4 points). Missing it was the most common real error: about half of the model notes left it out.

questions.question: Many notes order a lumbar puncture (CSF cytology and flow) but no baseline brain MRI, or an MRI only if symptoms appear. Does that meet CNS staging for this CNS-IPI 6 patient?
questions.context: Today the item requires both MRI brain and CSF studies.

questions.question: Giving high-dose methotrexate from cycle 1 despite creatinine 1.5, renal involvement and ongoing NSAIDs: how serious an error is that?
questions.context: Today it costs 4 points and does not fail the note.
options: Make it an unsafe error (fails the note)

questions.question: A note that writes 'stage III-IV' or 'III/IV' without committing to one stage: does it meet 'stages the disease IV'?
questions.context: Today a range does not count as a stage call, so the note fails the unsafe-error stage item.
options: A range counts as stage IV

questions.question: Full-dose R-CHOP x6 is accepted as curative treatment, and Pola-R-CHP earns a small 3-point bonus. Is that the right balance for this IPI 5 patient?
